milestone.title: Dogfood backlog close-out + remaining follow-ups — bulk AC update, auto-clear on complete, stale-evidence docs

intent.outcome: After this ships, the open dogfood backlog items B-53 (per-AC evidence stale-on-rerun), B-54 (stale block_reason / blocked_by post-completion), and B-57 (no bulk AC update) are closed with concrete fixes. B-46..B-52 are reflected as resolved in master-plan/backlog.json. Agents hitting any of the three remaining gaps have a documented path forward.

problem.description: Three open implementation items in mp-dogfood-log as of 2026-07-05 (post-M111-M117 batch): (1) Per-AC evidence is not rewritten on a clean `mp milestone complete` re-run (B-53 spec-gap, dogfood entry 'Per-AC evidence not rewritten on mp milestone complete clean re-run'); reviewers see historical `[force-bypassed: ...]` / `[skip-verify: ...]` annotations on each AC field even after a clean re-completion, contradicting the milestone-level `verification.evidence` which IS rewritten. The trade-off is defensible (preserve historical completion record) but is not documented. (2) M104's stale `block_reason` and `blocked_by: "user"` survive `mp milestone complete` re-runs (B-54 bug, dogfood 'M104 stale block_reason / blocked_by: user survive complete re-run'); the lifecycle state machine updates `execution_status` / `spec_status` to `done` / `verified` but leaves the block fields intact, producing a contradiction. Auto-clear on successful complete (or surface the contradiction in `mp validate`) is the fix. (3) The `mp milestone ac update` fragment surface has no `mp milestone ac update --bulk @file.json` batch path (B-57 spec-gap, mentioned in 3 dogfood entries: AC-evidence updates during M107, M107 spec's 5-AC fix, and the upstream `--replace-arrays` workaround); a 5-AC update currently requires 5 separate `--bulk`-less commands. Separately, B-46..B-52 were addressed in M111-M117 (some in M114, others in M112/M117) but the backlog.json status field was not updated; a small `mp backlog resolve B-NN --reason "shipped: ..."` sweep closes the file's audit trail.

in_scope: Bulk AC update subcommand (B-57): add `mp milestone ac update <id> --bulk @file.json` taking a JSON array of `{id, description?, verification?, evidence?}` updates; each fragment applied via the existing `mp milestone ac update <id> <ac_id> --<field> <value>` flow. Pinned by a test that updates three ACs in one invocation and asserts all three landed.

Auto-clear block fields on successful complete (B-54): when `mp milestone complete <id>` exits 0 and the milestone is now `done` + `verified`, clear `block_reason` and `blocked_by` automatically. The block was holding back completion; on clean completion the block is moot. The historical record is preserved as a comment-style annotation in `verification.evidence` (e.g. `[block-cleared-on-complete: was M106 testing milestone]`) so the audit trail is not lost. Pinned by a test that re-runs a blocked milestone with `mp milestone complete` and asserts both fields are empty afterward.

Document stale-evidence behavior (B-53): per-AC evidence is intentionally not rewritten on clean re-completion (per M107 design choice). Add a sentence to `crates/mp/docs/SPEC.md` (or `crates/mp/docs/verifier-design.md` if that exists) under the AC.verification section: `evidence` preserves historical annotations; reviewers should compare against `verification.evidence` for the current state. No code change; doc-only. Pinned by grep for the new sentence.

Update `master-plan/AGENTS.md` §0 / `mp scratch` rule to mention that freshly-added `mp backlog list` is the canonical way to find current backlog state (per M112 S1); M107-era hand-curated snippets are stale.

Backlog close-out (B-46..B-52): run `mp backlog resolve B-NN --reason "shipped: M### step"` for B-46 through B-52 so the backlog.json status field reflects M111-M117 closure. The work was done in code; the file's status was not updated. Pinned by `mp backlog list --status active` returning empty after the sweep.
out_of_scope: The M107 spec entries that already shipped (M111 S1 added `--evidence`; the agent can use that path now).
mp runtime perf and verify-lint work (covered by M110/M117).
B-56 (post_strip_validate test fixture) — low-priority test bug, deferred.
All wontfix items: agent-discipline (`/tmp/test_*.sh`, `mktemp -d`, `cat master-plan/milestones/*.json`, `cargo check` vs `make check`), git tag management, make vs cargo direct.

acceptance_criteria.description: `mp milestone ac update <id> --bulk @file.json` takes a JSON array and applies each element via the existing fragment update path; the response shape mirrors the per-AC update. Multiple ACs land in one invocation; an empty array is a no-op; an array referencing a missing AC id fails fast with a clear error. Pinned by a test that updates 3 ACs' descriptions in one call.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: AC-01 (bulk AC update subcommand) verified: cargo test -p mp --test ac_update_bulk. Test suite covers mp milestone ac bulk update — the B-57 gap (no bulk AC update) is closed. Test passes cleanly; per-AC bulk-update semantics are pinned.

acceptance_criteria.description: `mp milestone complete <id>` clears `block_reason` and `blocked_by` when the milestone transitions from in-flight to `done` / `verified`. The historical block context is preserved as a `[block-cleared-on-complete: <reason>]` annotation appended to `verification.evidence`. A no-op invocation (already-completed milestone with empty block fields) is a no-op. Pinned by a regression test that re-completes a previously-blocked milestone and asserts both block fields are empty after.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: AC-02 (auto-clear block on complete) verified: cargo test -p mp --test complete_clears_block_on_success. Test suite covers the B-54 gap (stale block_reason / blocked_by post-completion). On successful complete, the milestone record clears block_reason, blocked_at, blocked_by; the previous block context is preserved as a [block-cleared-on-complete: <reason>] annotation in verification.evidence for the audit trail.

acceptance_criteria.description: `crates/mp/docs/SPEC.md` (or the closest verifier-design doc) carries an explicit sentence explaining that per-AC `evidence` is intentionally not rewritten on clean re-completion, with a pointer to `verification.evidence` as the current-state channel. design_decisions.choice: Subcommand `--bulk @file.json` only (path-mode) — not stdin-mode. JSON array input avoids shell-quoting footguns; matches `mp milestone update --json @file` precedent for JSON-array wrap (cf. M93 fragment-first rules). The rollout path mirrors `mp milestone ac update` with no flag pollution: each fragment update still flows through the existing `mp milestone ac update <id> <ac_id> --<field> <value>` codepath; --bulk is purely a JSON dispatcher.
design_decisions.rationale: Stdin-mode (`--bulk @-`) is a future ergonomic extension. The first iteration covers path-mode to land the core mechanic; stdin adds shell-quoting complexity that the M108/M110 dogfood sweep flagged as avoidable risk for first-iteration ergonomics.

design_decisions.choice: Both auto-clear AND a historical annotation. The auto-clear prevents the contradiction (done + blocked_by:user); the annotation preserves the audit trail by appending `[block-cleared-on-complete: <reason>]` to verification.evidence. The inline annotation replaces the historical block_reason on disk; the first clean re-completion loses that field, but `verification.evidence_history` (a future M101 audit field if added) would record it.
design_decisions.rationale: Dropping the block field without preserving the reason would lose the M106/M104 audit context (the original block was for a real reason). Append-only evidence accumulation is consistent with the M107 design choice ('preserves the historical completion record') and gives reviewers a chronological view without double-bookkeeping. A validation contradiction gate (alternative B in the original dogfood entry) is more conservative but doubles documentation burden on every milestone that ever blocks; agents rarely set the block without intent, so the contradiction surface is a low-N case.

design_decisions.choice: Doc-only fix in SPEC.md. Adding an `evidence_history: []` array to each AC is the data-model option (would persist every verifier run's output) but is a larger change touching the persisted schema and JSON migration surface. Documenting the trade-off in SPEC.md is the low-friction path that closes the dogfood surface without a schema migration.
design_decisions.rationale: The M107 design choice was intentional and defensible; what's missing is the explicit document. A doc-only deliverable is the right size for a single S-sized milestone; the data-model upgrade (if it becomes valuable) is a future M101 follow-up.

design_decisions.choice: depends_on: [117] per the M111-M117 queue order convention. The work in this milestone touches the AC-verifier / complete paths (overlap with M117), but conceptually reads as the post-M117 backlog close-out. Adopting this milestone doesn't require M117 to have shipped the killpg work first — the changes are disjoint — but the queue ordering matches the user's M111-M117-N preference.
design_decisions.rationale: Both integer milestone ids and code coupling make M117 a sensible prerequisite. Code coupling to M117 is via `crates/mp/src/commands/milestone.rs` (modified by both this milestone and M117); M117's verifier hardening is upstream because M118's AC-02 (auto-clear block on complete) relies on the M107+M117 complete gate still working. Sequencing M118 after M117 keeps the AC path's invariants stable.
